decided_by: John, 2026-08-06 (option (a): delete only the genuinely false rows)
summary: Deletes the 8 /af override rows whose text asserts something untrue. A deleted row means the shipped messages/af.json default renders again — that is the documented reset mechanism (a row exists only where an admin edited away from the default). Every row here was written by Louwrens in good faith: he faithfully translated OUR July English, and the 2026-08-04 claims audit then corrected the English and left his Afrikaans frozen at July. The fault is ours; removing a false claim is not a wording judgement and does not wait for him. The remaining 41 rows are untouched — his Afrikaans wins by default.

not_included.why: AP-01 listed this as a false claim. It is not — 'geen rekening word benodig nie' vs 'geen rekening nodig nie' is a grammar preference with no claim content. His call.

His text is accurate. Ours only ADDS the disclosure that questions/lessons are still English-only (constraint 8). Deleting is probably right but it is a missing disclosure, not a falsehood — goes in the batch Louwrens sees.

Deleting this would make the site claim MORE, not less: ours adds 'getoets teen die amptelike reels' where his says only 'clear reasons in plain language'. A claims repair must not be the vehicle for shipping a new unreviewed claim.

ops.why: Overstates the free readiness test by 5x. The test is ~1 minute. Exact class the 2026-08-04 claims audit corrected in English.

AP-01 keyed this text to faqA5 and left faqA4 unclassified, so the plan as written would have deleted an innocent row and left this one live. Note 'vanlyn', not 'aflyn': the plan's verification grep checked only the other spelling and would have reported success.

ops.old: Ja. 'n Eenmalige betaling van R179 ontsluit alles vir 90 dae. Daarna is dit opsioneel: behou slegs die KI-afrigter vir R20 per maand as jy wil, of kanselleer wanneer jy ook al wil. Die R20 dek slegs die KI-koste — daar is geen volle intekening wat outomaties hernu word nie.
ops.restores_default_to: Ja. {price} eenmalig ontsluit alles vir 90 dae. Niks hernu outomaties nie, ons stoor geen kaart nie, en daar is geen maandelikse plan om te kanselleer nie — wanneer die 90 dae verstryk, hou toegang eenvoudig op.
ops.why: Two defects. (1) Hardcodes R179, bypassing src/lib/pricing.ts — the single source of truth — so it goes false the day the price moves; the default interpolates {price}. (2) Describes an R20/month AI-coach continuation as a live option. It is a PRD pricing intention (PRD-additions section 6), not a built feature — nothing in src/ sells or bills it.

ops.old: Egte K53-vrae wat ooreenstem met die nuutste handleiding.
ops.restores_default_to: Vrae geskryf uit die Nasionale Padverkeerswet, die regulasies daarby en die amptelike tekenkaart.
ops.why: 'Real K53 questions matching the latest manual' is unverifiable and implies a source we deliberately do not use — constraint 7 forbids commercial study guides as a source. The default states what is actually true and provable: the questions are written from the Act, the regulations and the official chart.

ops.old: VVir leerders onder 18 moet 'n ouer of voog toestemming gee voordat ons persoonlike vordering stoor.
ops.restores_default_to: Jou gratis gereedheidsuitslag bly op jou eie toestel totdat jy kies om 'n rekening te skep.
ops.why: Promises parent/guardian consent for under-18s on the privacy page. It is not implemented: profiles.parent_consent exists as a column and nothing in src/ ever reads or writes it. The 2026-08-04 claims audit removed this in English; the override kept it live in Afrikaans. Also carries a visible 'VVir' typo.
